## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive; weak breadth with conflicting internals confirms the CAUTION call. Leadership concentrated and narrow (Top 5: 5/5 Technology) and major large-cap divergence (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META mixed) provide the second confirmation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare follows with LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials also strong with CAT (1W: +8.20% | 1M: +21.58%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Real Estate, Energy and Communication are lagging: AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated outside the tech leadership pocket.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: +11.86% | 1M: +23.36%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +11.75% | 1M: +12.56%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CEG (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -13.69%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.12% | 1M: -10.56%) BELOW TREND, T (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -16.53%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Real Estate/Comm/Select Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +17.22% | 1M: +21.06%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND; watch TSLA (1W: +10.22% | 1M: -3.49%) RECOVERY and CHTR (1W: +7.94% | 1M: -1.28%) RECOVERY as short-term bounces inside a cautious tape.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: megacap tech showing divergence while semicap/equipment names are charging — AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, but AAPL (1W: -1.68% | 1M: -7.27%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -0.25% | 1M: -17.15%) BELOW TREND; Sector performance 1W: +3.43% with mixed internals.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak near-term: V (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +5.13%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +5.23% | 1M: +3.97%) ABOVE TREND contrast with CME (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -18.85%) BELOW TREND and JPM (1W: -2.04% | 1M: +9.36%) in CORRECTION, leaving Financials 1W: -1.30% and inconsistent leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive but selective strength: JNJ (1W: +6.23% | 1M: +12.71%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +9.91%) ABOVE TREND support sector upside (1W: +3.14%) despite headline risk on AMGN.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to chip-equipment and high-quality healthcare (AMAT, LRCX, LLY) while reducing exposure to lagging Communication and select Real Estate names; style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and broad divergence. Monitor big-cap tech trend breaks before adding to growth positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +23.40% | 1M: +60.65%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +8.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -11.27% | 1M: -35.09%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -9.47% | 1M: -26.11%) BELOW TREND, AMT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.43%) and Healthcare (1W: +3.14%) for momentum; BEARISH: Real Estate (1W: -2.79%) and Communication (1W: -1.74%) for continued pressure — Breadth remains weak at 4/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AMAT for sustainment above this week’s highs to confirm continuation (ABOVE TREND). Watch ORCL for a break below recent lows to confirm continued downside (BELOW TREND). Watch JPM to reclaim its 1M trend for Financials risk-on confirmation (CORRECTION).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LRCX (+60): Chip tool bullish headline confirms price action — LRCX (1W: +16.70% | 1M: +36.29%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment and price aligned. CEG (+60): Bullish utility M&A/ppa headline but CEG (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -13.69%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, watch for redistribution.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-65): Regulatory/legal headline aligns with weak 1M; META (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -10.86%) RECOVERY and news confirms downside risk. GOOGL (-50): Antitrust headline with GOOGL (1W: +3.25% | 1M: -5.98%) RECOVERY — watch for trend failure. DOW (-50): Negative coverage matches DOW (1W: -9.79% | 1M: -18.93%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership as narrow tech strength sits against weak breadth. AMAT, LRCX and LLY showing strength (ABOVE TREND) while AAPL, MSFT and ORCL show weakness (BELOW TREND / CORRECTION). Key risk is major-cap divergence and negative headlines on META/GOOGL/AMGN that could sap breadth and stall the tech pocket.
